prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic Y2K-inspired flash portrait inside a vehicle at night.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult blonde woman with layered voluminous hair and darker roots, winged eyeliner, glossy nude-pink lips, reclining comfortably in a car seat, wearing a two-tone opaque long-sleeve raglan top and light-wash jeans with layered silver jewelry and blue manicure.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level close-up framing upper body and waist, cheek resting lightly on one hand, dark car interior and headrest, window reflections of street lights, optional subtle belly jewelry only if supplied and not emphasized.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct on-camera flash creates bright face and hair highlights and deep background shadows, authentic Y2K candid nightlife grain.
prompt.technical_specs: 4K photorealistic smartphone close-up, sharp subject, natural grain, realistic skin and denim texture, eye-level camera.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic Y2K-inspired flash portrait of an approved adult blonde woman with layered voluminous hair and darker roots inside a vehicle at night. She has fair natural skin, winged eyeliner, groomed brows, and glossy pinkish-nude lips, reclining comfortably with her cheek resting lightly on her right hand. She wears a two-tone opaque long-sleeve raglan top in light teal and maroon, light-wash blue jeans, layered silver necklaces including a square pendant, a silver chain bracelet with heart charm, a dome ring, blue manicure, and small ear jewelry. The dark car interior has a black headrest and window reflections of street lights. Use direct flash, bright hair highlights, deep background shadows, 4K photorealistic texture, and authentic Y2K nightlife grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, crop top, exposed midriff, low-rise emphasis, belly-piercing focus, sexualized pose, nudity, brand logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, hair, wardrobe palette, vehicle, flash, and jewelry; replaceable details include graphic print and small accessories. Keep coverage opaque and do not emphasize piercing or logos.

changes: Clarified approved adult and replaced crop/low-rise exposure and piercing emphasis with opaque long sleeves, jeans, and neutral jewelry styling.
